'''Kin Kian''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] who served in [[Aggressor Wing]] six months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
Kin Kian served in [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm's]] [[Aggressor Wing]] six months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Partnered with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Telsij Cayr]] in [[Aggressor Seven]], Kian participated in the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]]. During Aggressor Wing's assault on the city of [[Oradin]], Cayr and Kian's [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] was shot down by a pilot from the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]]. Although Cayr survived, Kian was killed in the crash.

==Behind the scenes==
Kin Kian first appeared in [[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 23|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 23]] in [[1997]]. In [[2000]], [[Decipher]] released their ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], identified an unnamed Human pilot as from the Endor briefing as Kin Kian. Whether or not the character on the CCG card was intended to be this character is unknown.
